items: Book is a label on the node, not the node's unique id.
The properties in braces store the sample id, title and page count; RETURN reads the new title.

blocks.text: A Book node is created and Moon Trip is returned.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: CREATE always creates a new node. Repeating it can create duplicates unless a suitable constraint stops it.
